classifications.direct-successor-capability: The v1alpha2 authoring contract expresses this authority directly.
classifications.runtime-owned-equivalent: The successor runtime preserves this behavior without requiring procedural YAML.
classifications.generalized-replacement: A successor needs a broader declarative capability; do not mechanically copy this field.
classifications.compatibility-only: No current successor equivalent exists; retain this v1alpha1 construct until one is specified.

capabilities.note: Use a new v1alpha2 document; never change the version in place.
The write allowlist is preserved exactly.
Named actor capabilities are authored directly in v1alpha2.
v1alpha2 intentionally has no inherited agent defaults; declare effective named-agent capabilities directly.
The successor runtime owns lifecycle defaults and checkpoint sequencing.
Use direct phase kind, reasoning, requiresChange, and validation where equivalent; do not copy lifecycle programs.
Phase IDs, actors, prompts, and named validation remain explicit.
The final deterministic gate remains a distinct completion transition.

capabilities.successor: runtime safe-resume, checkpoint, durable evidence, and completion transition
capabilities.note: These durable mechanics remain visible in the expanded plan but are not successor authoring fields.

capabilities.successor: spec.tools, spec.validation.steps, dependencies, hard, and repair.once
capabilities.note: Reusable deterministic tools, multi-step gates, evidence dependencies, and bounded repair are authored directly; legacy failure programs remain runtime-owned or compatibility-only.
The concise shell validation shorthand is preserved directly.

capabilities.successor: v1alpha2 parameters, workspace initialization/integrity, preconditions, graph-node controls, humanGates, completion assertions, and reset policy
capabilities.note: Portable authority is direct, but represented with concise policy names rather than legacy procedural fields.

capabilities.successor: agentflow.dev/v1alpha4 spec.criteria, phase workItem/advanceWorkItem, and optional markdownChecklist adapter
capabilities.note: Migrate stable declared criteria to typed work items and exact-target engine advancement; a Markdown checklist may be retained only as a presentation adapter. This is an authority-preserving redesign, not a field copy, and does not replace runtime rediscovery loops.
First-unchecked runtime selection participates in dynamic rediscovery. v1alpha4 supports only explicitly declared work items and bounded static expansion, so retain this selection in v1alpha1.
v1alpha4 forEach expands a statically declared bounded collection only; v1alpha1 next-unchecked runtime rediscovery and dispatch loops remain compatibility-only.

capabilities.successor: successor policy, graph node, tool, validation, human-gate, completion, or v1alpha4 presentation-adapter capability
capabilities.note: Use the concise successor authority where one exists; retain repository-specific bookkeeping that cannot be represented by a v1alpha4 Markdown checklist adapter.
Keep the v1alpha1 document as the compatibility contract until a successor explicitly models a replacement.
